title: Indonesia cites lack of forestry permits in land seizures from nickel miners
body: President Prabowo Subianto said last week that more than 1,000 illegal mining operations were identified.

title: Antam Reports 240% Net Profit Surge in 1H25, Driven by Nickel Boom and Strong Gold Sales
body: PT Antam posted a 240% jump in net profit to Rp5.14 trillion in the first half of 2025, largely thanks to a nickel profit of Rp3.53 trillion and sales of Rp7.87 trillion, with ore production up 117% to 9.10 Mt and sales volume 144% to 8.20 Mt, while gold sales rose 163% to Rp49.54 trillion and 29,305 kg. The company also advanced its ESG agenda, launching a 2030 decarbonization roadmap, achieving 75% land rehabilitation, and progressing its SGAR alumina smelter project in Mempawah, positioning Antam as a leader in Indonesia’s mining sector.

title: PT Timah Tbk Reports 2025 Q1 Production and Profit Declines, Outlines Recovery Plan and Seeks Regulatory Support
body: PT Timah Tbk disclosed a 32% drop in tin ore production and a 19% revenue decline in the first half of 2025, while its average selling price rose 8% to USD 32,816 per metric ton. The company outlined a recovery roadmap that includes opening new mines, expanding KIP partnerships, boosting community cooperatives, and requested DPR VI support to streamline regulations on illegal mining, hilirisasi, and coastal zoning to restore output and enhance national revenue.
